```r
not_inches_or_cm <- function(x, smallest = 50, tallest = 84){
 inches <- [suppressWarnings](https://rdrr.io/r/base/warning.html)([as.numeric](https://rdrr.io/r/base/numeric.html)(x))
 [is.na](https://rdrr.io/r/base/NA.html)(inches) |
 !((inches >= smallest & inches <= tallest) |
 (inches/2.54 >= smallest & inches/2.54 <= tallest))
}
```

```r
patterns <- [c](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)(feet = "[4-7](?=\\s*'\\s*)", 
 "\\s*'\\s*", 
 inches = "\\d+\\.?\\d*")
smallest <- 50
tallest <- 84
new_heights <- reported_heights |> 
 [mutate](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate.html)(original = height, 
 height = convert_format(cleanup(height))) |>
 [separate_wider_regex](https://tidyr.tidyverse.org/reference/separate_wider_delim.html)(height, patterns = patterns, 
 too_few = "align_start", 
 cols_remove = FALSE) |> 
 [mutate](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate.html)([across](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/across.html)([c](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)(height, feet, inches), as.numeric)) |>
 [mutate](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate.html)(guess = 12 * feet + inches) |>
 [mutate](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate.html)(height = [case_when](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/case_when.html)(
 [is.na](https://rdrr.io/r/base/NA.html)(height) ~ [as.numeric](https://rdrr.io/r/base/numeric.html)(NA),
 [between](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/between.html)(height, smallest, tallest) ~ height,  #inches
 [between](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/between.html)(height/2.54, smallest, tallest) ~ height/2.54, #cm
 [between](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/between.html)(height*100/2.54, smallest, tallest) ~ height*100/2.54, #meters
 TRUE ~ [as.numeric](https://rdrr.io/r/base/numeric.html)(NA))) |>
 [mutate](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate.html)(height = [ifelse](https://rdrr.io/r/base/ifelse.html)([is.na](https://rdrr.io/r/base/NA.html)(height) & 
 inches <= 12 & [between](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/between.html)(guess, smallest, tallest),
 guess, height)) |>
 [select](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/select.html)(-feet, -inches, -guess)
```
